Em 2026, a ANPD monitorou a indicação do: In 2026, the ANPD monitored 56 processing agents for the appointment of a DPO and the existence of a channel with data subjects. Em fevereiro de 2026, a Lei 15.352 trans: In February 2026, Law 15,352 turned the ANPD into the National Data Protection Agency, with functional, technical, decision-making, administrative and financial autonomy. In 2026, the ANPD completed its monitoring of 56 processing agents (39 public bodies and 17 private companies) on two basic obligations, the formal appointment of a DPO and the provision of a communication channel with data subjects, and the 21 that did not respond to its letters were referred to the sanctions area, which may open sanctioning proceedings. The ANPD's first sanction with a fine, in 2023, hit a micro-enterprise (R$ 14,400.00 in total), showing that small size does not rule out a sanction.

Qualquer informação que identifique ou p: Any information that identifies or could identify a natural person: name, email, tax ID, address, location, or even a device identifier.
Qualquer operação feita com dado pessoal: Any operation performed on personal data: collection, production, receipt, classification, use, access, reproduction, transmission, distribution, processing, archiving, storage, deletion, evaluation, control, modification, communication, transfer, dissemination or extraction.
Qualquer pessoa cujo dado a empresa trat: Anyone whose data the company processes has the right to request access to, correction or deletion of that data. The system already has a public portal ready to receive these requests.
Quando a hipótese legal é \"Consentiment: When the legal basis is "Consent", a shield icon appears on the activity card. It opens a QR code and a public link to collect formal consent, recording name, email, IP address and date.
Quem decide o que fazer com o dado pesso: Whoever decides what to do with personal data, for what purpose and how. It is usually the company you represent in the system.
Quem lida com dados no dia a dia precisa: People who handle data day to day need to know what to do. Guiding employees and contractors is part of the DPO's duties.
Quem trata dado pessoal em nome do contr: Whoever processes personal data on behalf of the controller, following its instructions. Cloud, payroll and AI tools are all processors when they handle your company's data.
Quem trata dados em nome da empresa prec: Those who process data on the company's behalf must follow its instructions, and sending data to another country requires a safeguard provided by law.

Siga as etapas em ordem. Aplicável a est: Follow the stages in order. Applicable to this unit:
Siga o Caminho de Adequação, no menu lat: Follow the Compliance Path in the side menu: it shows the stages in order, the LGPD or GDPR articles and what is missing in each one. 1. Run the Initial Assessment (the first stage of the Path), which identifies real gaps and creates the first tasks in the Action Plan for you. 2. Open the Action Plan and start with the simplest tasks; each one points to the right module of the system. 3. Titulares podem exercer direitos sobre s: Data subjects can exercise rights over their data, with a response deadline. Incidents of relevant risk must be reported to the authority and, where applicable, to the people affected.
Toda atividade de tratamento precisa se: Every processing activity must rely on one of the legal grounds set by law: consent, performance of a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, among others. It is the first item the ROPA asks for each activity.
Toda ação relevante, criação, aprovação,: Every relevant action, whether creation, approval, rejection, AI generation or status change, is recorded in an immutable audit trail showing who did it, when and what changed. This even includes what the artificial intelligence itself generated and who later reviewed and approved it. The trail can be viewed, and exported as CSV, in the Audit tab.
Toda empresa que processa dado em nome d: Every company that processes data on your behalf, such as cloud, payroll or AI tools, is a processor and needs a formal agreement (DPA) confirming how it handles that data.
Toda resposta \"Não\" gera automaticamen: Every "No" answer automatically creates a task in the Action Plan, with a title and description pointing to the right module of the system. If you answer "Yes" to everything, the system confirms that no gaps were identified in the assessment questions.
Toda solicitação recebida gera automatic: Every request received automatically creates a linked task in the company's Action Plan.

Todo documento nasce como Rascunho (DRAF: Every document starts as a Draft (DRAFT). Using "Generate with AI" turns it into Generated (GENERATED). Someone marks it as Reviewed (REVIEWED), and only then can an Administrator Approve it (APPROVED), the only state in which the content is considered official and starts serving as context for other documents.
Todo uso de dado pessoal precisa de fund: Every use of personal data needs a legal ground and cannot last forever. When the ground is consent, the company must be able to prove it.
Tratamento necessário para atender inter: Processing necessary to serve the legitimate interests of the controller, provided they do not override the data subject's fundamental rights.
Tratamento necessário para exercício de: Processing necessary to exercise rights in judicial, administrative or arbitration proceedings.
Tratamento necessário para proteger a vi: Processing necessary to protect the life or physical safety of the data subject or a third party.
Tratamento para proteção do crédito, inc: Processing for credit protection, including as provided in the relevant legislation.
Tratamento realizado para a realização d: Processing carried out for studies, with anonymization guaranteed whenever possible.
Tratamento realizado pela administração: Processing carried out by public authorities to execute policies provided for by law.
Tratamento realizado por profissionais d: Processing carried out by health professionals or health authorities to protect the data subject's health.
